correctness.rationale: In characteristic 2, all derivations of A=k[x,y]/(x²,y²) are f∂x+g∂y with f,g arbitrary four-term elements. D² is a derivation, so D²=D iff D(f)=f and D(g)=g. When constants a=e=0 the linear coefficient P satisfies P²=P; quadratic row Q obeys QP+(tr P)Q=Q, producing 0, rank-one-projector and identity strata with q counts 1, q²(q+1), q². When constant vector nonzero, normalize to (1,0): f=1+x+c y+c i xy, g=i y+(i+i²)xy with free c,i, giving q²(q²-1) points. Quadratic shears and linear changes give three nonzero orbits; degeneration from (s+x)∂x and (s+x)∂x+y∂y connects rank-1 and rank-2 linear classes to open 4-fold, leaving zero isolated. Tangent linearization H↦DH+HD−H has kernel dimension 0 at zero and 4 at each nonzero representative, equal local geometric dimension, establishing smoothness, geometric irreducibility of the fourfold. Independently exhaustive *full derivation* enumeration over F2 (256 candidates) and F4 (65536 candidates) produced 29 and 337 idempotents with all 28/336 nonzero maps rank2; representative Jacobian kernel dimensions 0,4,4,4 over F2. Finite examples corroborate universal proof.

originality.rationale: No published inspected stronger result gives composition-idempotent derivation scheme, 4 orbits, smoothness and precise q^4+q^3+q²+1 polynomial for this commutative characteristic-two truncated plane. Existing rank-polynomial work counts ALL derivations and identifies automorphism nonsmoothness, which does not determine idempotent derivations; another idempotent study assumes quantum skew parameters c_ij distinct from ±1, excluding the present commutative algebra (parameter 1). Older toral classification for restricted Witt algebras may contain an implicit orbit statement and remains a named risk, but no direct coverage is established.
residual_risks: An obscure classification of restricted Lie maximal tori/toral elements in characteristic two might imply part of orbit theorem; full historical review incomplete.
The proof establishes smoothness of the idempotent-derivation **scheme**, not smoothness of the ambient automorphism group scheme (which prior literature notes is nonreduced).
F2/F4 computations are finite corroboration, not an all-field proof.
